A great way to get elevated to start your day, or to complete a task that you’ve been procrastinating! Let the flavors of sweet woodsy citrus embrace you for your journey - you’re gonna need it!

Users are likely to experience more relaxed effects reminiscent of a balanced and mellow hybrid, while still experiencing a slight euphoria.

A fruity & hella funky cross of Banana MAC (GDF) x Mac & Cheese (Vivid), this uplifting sativa-hybrid brings sour cheese aromas followed by a banana pudding exhale. Effects are euphoric and stress-relieving, making it perfect for hash heads throughout the entire day!

As previously stated, flavors are extremely fruity and citrusy with a sour funk undertone that is truly one of a kind and will have your mouth watering for more!

records.notes: Sweet citrus, cereal and rotten orange peels
records.description: Also known as Superboof, Blockberry is a cross of Tropicana Cookies and Black Cherry Punch.  It's a 50/50 hybrid that has hints of creamy orange vanilla that's backed by an sweet, cereal aroma.  This one is great for all day dabbing and will leave your palate lingering for more.

records.name: Blueberry Blushie · Live Rosin Cart
records.notes: Blueberry muffins boxed up in a closed car
records.description: Blueberry Blushie is pure dessert shop energy. Strawberry Candy brings bright, sugary berry notes with a sharp, jammy pop, while Blueberry Muffin rounds it out with warm, baked sweetness and a soft, doughy finish. Pressed together, the result is a layered, fruit-forward rosin that’s loud on the nose, smooth on the dab, and ridiculously satisfying from start to finish.

records.name: Blueberry Clem2 · Mini Hash Hole
records.notes: Blueberry Breakfast in a Citrus Grove
records.description: A bright, fruit-forward hash hole bursting with sweet blueberry depth and zesty clementine citrus. The flower and hash combine for a smooth, creamy burn that starts with a lively, euphoric lift before settling into a mellow, floaty body vibe. Expect juicy berry sweetness, sparkling orange rind, and a terp-rich finish that lingers like citrus jam on warm air. Perfect for daytime creativity, shared sessions, or a flavorful cruise through your afternoon.

records.name: Blueberry Muffin · Live Rosin
records.description: Not quite like grandma used to make, but made with the same amount of love. This indica-dominant single strain offering packs all of the blueberry, doughy terps this strain is known for in one package.

records.name: Booberry · Sauce Cart

records.name: Brain Maze · Live Rosin
records.description: A bright, candy-loud blend that splashes together the creamy Z terps of Compound Z #2, the tropical banana-lime funk of Tallymon, and the electric cherry pop of Trop Cherry. Expect a wave of fruit-forward aroma — fizzy citrus, tropical smoothie sweetness, and sticky cherry gas wrapped in a creamy, Zkittlez-style finish.

records.name: BruleeBerry Muffin · Live Rosin Cart
records.description: Skunky muffins baking in the oven is what you’ll get from this Indica Dominant Hybrid blend of Flex Fuel and Blueberry Muffin. The Headchange Dab Kitchen has outdone itself with this one as it will lift your senses up while giving you that buzzy kick towards the end with notes of blueberry to finish off the skunky earth tones.

records.name: Brunana Breeze · Sauce Cart
records.description: Let Brunana Breeze float you away to your happy place! Feel like your toes are in the sand, stretch out and relax with the help of this hybrid blend. Brunana Breeze is crossed with Banana Coffee x King Sherb IX. The rich floral banana flavors really shine through with each inhale! Brunana Breeze offers relaxation, euphoria and stress relief. Sit back and enjoy the breeeeeeeeze!

records.name: Bubbas Graveyard · Live Badder
records.description: There's magic made when Kush strains combine with Chem combinations, those old school flavors are purely and utterly to die for. Presenting Bubbas Graveyard: a deadly blend of Vertical Kush + Chem Dawg, this balanced hybrid blend pulls together two legendary strains into one perfect pairing of lethal terps. Relish in the skunky, piney, chem flavors that bring you back like a flash to the past! Enjoy mellow, happy, and relaxing effects with this special drop!

records.name: Bubblegum Blackhole · Live Badder
records.description: Prepare for a gravitational pull of pure deliciousness and cosmic euphoria with Bubblegum Blackhole. This interstellar blend of Indiana Bubblegum, Apple Fritter, and Gelato 41 will warp your taste buds before launching your mind into a vibrant nebula of delight. Perfect for those moments when you crave an escape into a galaxy of gourmet flavors and an orbit of blissful, mind-expanding effects. Get ready to be deliciously consumed.

I hope you like to kick it!

records.description: A shoutout to another St. Louis staple, Cardinal Cream Cough is a indica dominant blend of Biscotti and Strawberry Float. records.name: Cereal Dubz · Sauce Cart
records.description: This one is a real winner! A creamy and earthy blend of Cereal Milk x Double Cross gives off heavy OG vibes with a hint of sweet milk afternotes. Effects include a mellowed-out body high combined with a zoned out cerebral stone, which is great for end of day stress and pain relief without the super-sleepiness to ensure that every hit is a true DUB!

records.description: CheeseBreath is a hybrid blend of Mac and Cheese and Kaleidoscope.  The flavor profile is citrusy and cheesy, with hints of flowers. records.description: The terp wizards at the Headchange headquarters are at it again, having concocted a magical blend of the funky Mac & Cheese, the sweet Peach Crescendo, and the sour Dawg Lemons, bringing into the world: Cheezy Poofy! This blend will certainly have you feeling a little sour, and a little sweet. With the top terps being terpinolene, limonene, and myrcene, Cheezy Poofy is a great blend to get some of those “to-dos” checked off that list of yours.

records.name: Chefs Kiss · Live Rosin
records.description: This decadent blend of Cereal Milk and Rainbow Belts is *chefs kiss*. So we name it Chefs Kiss! This sweet, fruity, and earthy combo is absolutely mouthwatering and leaves a coat of terps on the lips. A good smoke for day or night providing a night heavy high.

records.name: Chem 51 · Live Rosin Cart
records.description: Heavy chem gas with that greasy, sharp edge that fills the room fast. It hits loud and lingers, with a faint sweetness buried underneath the weight.

records.name: ChemChi 2.0 · Live Badder
records.description: A new take on one of my personal old favorites from us, Chemchi 2.0 is an updated cultivar of our beloved Chemchi strain. This one is Chem D crossed with Mac and Cheese, and it creates a super citrusy and earthy inhale with a gassy exhale. A sativa leaning hybrid, this is a great mid-afternoon strain to power you through those last couple hours or if you need a spark of creativity to complete your project.

records.name: ChemChi 3.0 · Sauce Cart
records.description: People can't get enough of it, so we're runnin it back. ChemDawg OG + Mac and Cheese gives you ChemChi 3.0, a sativa-dominant hybrid just like it's predecessors. Super citrusy, super peppery,  with a nice chemmy finish at the very end of the exhale.  Great for a morning and afternoon smoke.  Get's the juices flowin'.

Chilly Dawg is great for anxiety and stress relief with its mood-boosting properties, but is also relaxing enough to avoid paranoia.

records.description: The sticky sweetness that is the Chinese Glueberry can only be found within the deep hash jungles where people scarcely venture, but the Hastronauts will travel anywhere to secure the funkiest and freshest terps. Further analysis of the fruit shows a cross of Member Berry x Zookies, which provides flavors of blackberry bushes, earth, and heavy cream. Effects are medicating and relaxing– great for stress relief and end-of-day activities to wind down for the evening.

records.description: We like to imagine – what if Cinderella was a bad bitch from Missouri? She would definitely be girl-boss material, just like all of the terp queens slinging the HeadChange around the state, and you just know she has some badass purple slippers stowed away somewhere! A remix of one of our older crosses, this strain is a blend of Grand Daddy Purple x Cinderella ‘99, and provides nice, sedative effects with a slight euphoric uptick and an earthy, sour scent. This magic usually only lasts until the clock strikes midnight, at which point the spell takes over and whisks you to dreamland.

Thick, terp-heavy dabs with a sticky, flavorful finish — perfect for evening sessions and flavor chasers who like their candy with gas.

records.description: Presenting Funkenstein, straight from the funkonaut wizards at the lab; your next sesh is sure to be electrified! Funkenstien is a lively concoction of Flex Fuel + Wilfunk + Grease Monkey. Great for solo jamming or group seshing, this upbeat blend is sure to resurrect the party into your day! With fizzling fuel tones, groovy greasey notes, and fermented fruit aromas, Funkenstien is sure to tear down the dance floor and your tastebuds!

records.description: Grape & Strawberry -- move over! Funky is here to stay! A blend of Peanut Butter Acai x GMO Cookies has a nutty, herbal flavor profile with hints of fresh mint and PB&J. Effects are body focused and more relaxing than they are stimulating, and can potentially cause some killer munchies!

It's super strong and garlicky upfront on the inhale, with a gassy ctirus finish similar to candied cantaloupes.  Perfect for any time use in small amounts to manage pain and anxiety, and in larger doses it's wonderful for treating insomnia, turning you into a bit of a funky monkey yourself.

records.name: Funky Pajamas · Live Badder
records.notes: Frosted Cereal in a Funky Disco
records.description: The effects are purely heady. Expect a creative and euphoric dance to begin in your mind, inspiring deep thoughts and artistic pursuits. Funky Pajamas is the perfect uniform for late-night jam sessions, deep-dive conversations, or just getting comfortable with your own consciousness. Get ready to get funky.

records.name: Galactic Funk · Mini Hash Hole
records.notes: Vanilla dough topped with pine needles
records.description: This mini hash hole pairs rich, doughy Wedding Cake flower with a high-voltage infusion of Ghost Train Haze rosin, creating a smoke that’s both decadent and electric. It starts with creamy vanilla frosting and sweet cake batter, then gets ripped open by sharp citrus, lemon haze, and a streak of spicy fuel from the rosin core.

records.name: Galaxy Gush · Live Rosin
records.notes: Planet Born in the Stank Nebula
records.description: Introducing Galaxy Gush! Combining two class favorites amongst MO cannabis users, this cosmic collision of flavors is otherworldly! Galaxy Gush is a heady mix of Gush Mints + Bananaconda. Sweet gassy tang marries with candied mint bananas creating a constellation of explosive aromas and tastes! Enjoy mellow waves of euphoria through your mind and body while gently gliding through the cosmos of relaxation with this new drop!

records.name: Gangster Funk · Live Rosin
records.description: Little funk and a little crunk! We are so excited to introduce Gangster Funk! Gangster Funk is a perfectly curated combination of Wilfunk x Flex Fuel. This hybrid blend is packed with earthy, gassy, undertones and of course: the FUNK! Enjoy effects like relaxation, stress relief, and mood enhancement!

records.name: Garbage Pail Kush · Live Rosin
records.description: Introducing Garbage Pail Kush: It's a dumpster dive into delight with genetics straight out of Sour Tangie and GMO Cookies. This indica is like finding a hidden treasure in the trash—smooth, sweet, and guaranteed to lift your spirits higher than the dumpster lid. Embrace the absurdity and let Garbage Pail Kush take you on a wild ride through a haze of citrusy bliss and funky cookie dreams. Who knew garbage could be so good?

A blend of Mac & Cheese x Great Aunt’s Secret (GAS), this one provides notes of sour lemon rinds & kush, with an earthy exhale. Effects are a mix of cerebral and body, with mood-boosting and relaxation coming together to provide a wonderful bliss that’s great for stress relief during break times or just during a day off!

Expect rich funky, gassy diesel flavors from this new drop!

records.description: Concentrated Lemon essence and the familiar wild haze terps jump straight out of the jar on this one. Loud, zesty, and unmistakably classic. Pure haze character, wide awake. There's a train comin' to town.

records.description: Heavy on the glue, never light on the terps. This blend of Gorilla Pie x GG #4 showcases just how amazing these two strains can be, and how bringing them together really makes some magic. Intensely cerebral highs followed by stoney eyes are any GG lovers dream, and on the tail-end puts you in bed to stay there for awhile.

records.description: Bright citrus candy smashed into sweet cherry syrup with a thick layer of gas underneath. It opens juicy and sugary, then rolls into a deeper, creamy funk that lingers on the nose. Sweet, tangy, and fuel-laced.

records.name: GodSmack #3 · Sauce Cart
records.description: Godsmack #3 is an indica dominant blend of Heavy Fog and Bear Slaps #3. Expect flavors of skunk, sandalwood, and pepper. This cultivar is great for treating depression and anxiety as well as boosting creativity and a great overall mood booster.

records.description: Take a trip to the other dimensions and see the harmony of the universe with this psychedelic cross of Gas Truffle x Golden Goat. A fat enough rip will have you hollering “good googly moogly” so proceed accordingly.

records.description: Just like the outdated internet beast of the past, this chronic blend will have you going slowwwwwww. This strain is a cross of Wifi OG x Grand Daddy Purple and is coded to provide an insanely heavy body relaxation combined with an earthy & minty kush flavor. Don’t plan on doing anything wild – towards the end the effects become sleepy and sedative and will have you powering down before you know it!

Treat yourself to a banger of bliss with Grape Pudding - because life should always be this delicious!

records.description: Trap Lemonade is our secret recipe, a perfect fusion of Lemon Cheese and Alien Mintz, guaranteed to quench your thirst and elevate your vibe. Imagine a zesty squeeze of lemon with a cool, minty twist, served up with a side of that smooth, balanced high. One hit, and you'll be chillin' like a kingpin, savoring the sweet and tangy flavors. So, step right up, take a sip, and let Trap Lemonade take you on a wild ride. Cheers, homie!

records.name: Tréso · Sauce Cart
records.description: They say magic works in threes and we couldnt agree more with this exotic TRIPLE BLEND of Lava Cake x Berkel x Coka. Effects are relaxed, potentially sedative, and overall body-focused, accomapnied by a gassy & funky honeysuckle aroma and taste.

records.name: Triangle Kush · Live Rosin
records.description: Triangle Kush is a classic heavy hitter known for its deep gas, earthy spice, and unmistakable kush funk. It leads with sharp diesel and lemon peel, backed by pine, pepper, and rich earthy notes that coat the palate from start to finish.

records.name: Triple Burger · Live Rosin
records.description: Another one of our single source strains from Amaze, and this one has got to be the funkiest! This strain’s genetics are a cross of GMO x Double Burger, and provides insanely relaxing effects that are also mood boosting– perfect for stress relief! Flavors are dank and savory with a garlic, butter, and slightly umami undertone perfect for those looking to experience some awesome food-inspired terps!

records.name: Trippy Belts · Live Badder
records.description: We've been loving the Rainbow Belts terps lately so we decided to do another Belts blend. Not for us, for you, the hashish people. Rainbow Belts and Tye Dye come together to deliver a predominantly fruity cultivar with hints of pine. Great for users seeking relief from stress, pain, or looking to increase their appetite.

Rainbow Belts and Tye Dye come together to deliver a predominantly fruity cultivar with hints of pine.  Great for users seeking relief from stress, pain, or looking to increase their appetite.

records.name: Tropaconda · Live Rosin
records.description: Catch this exclusive thriller in a dispo near you! A cinematic blend of Trop Cherry x Bananaconda has such an intricate plot of flavors like cherries, gas, funk, & fruit! Spoiler Alert: the finale ends with you getting super stoned!

records.name: Tropaconda 2: Bites Back · Live Rosin
records.description: You’ve seen the blockbuster hit Tropaconda, now comes the sequel of epic proportions Tropaconda 2: Bites Back! An epic tale told through the power of our hash. With flavors bigger and brighter like you’ve never seen on the big screen before. Coming to a dispensary near you in 3D and IMAX!

records.name: Tropaconda 3: Blood Orange · Live Rosin
records.description: Rated the #1 Movie in America -- we bring the third installment to our epic trilogy -- Tropaconda 3: Blood Orange! You thought you tried in all in Tropaconda 1 and 2, but Tropaconda 3: Blood Orange is a multi-dimensional experience like never before. See how this trilogy ends in this blaze of terpy glory, coming to a dispensary near you!

records.name: Trop Cream Paint Job · Sauce Cart
records.description: This live resin sauce cart is cream on the inside. This Dorrough approved blend is an indica dominant cultivar, made by mixing Gushcanna #4 and Bubblegum Ice Cream. The resulting flavors are creamy and fruity, with a slightly diesel exhale. It's cream on the inside, and clean on the inside too cause you already know we don't CRC our hash to keep it as true to the plant as possible.

records.name: Trop Drop N' Roll · Mini Hash Hole
records.description: This one is fire - do you remember what to do? Trop, Drop, and Roll! But we did the rolling for you - and infused the inside with Trop Cherry Live Rosin.

records.name: Tropelation · Live Rosin
records.description: Prepare for Tropelation, a blend that is both a lush, tropical escape and a profound mental awakening. Your journey begins with a wave of exotic flavor, where the sweet, sun-drenched nectar of Papaya Juice collides with the rich, bold sweetness of Buff Cherry. The taste is a vibrant, island-inspired delight that instantly transports you to paradise.

records.name: Trop Galaxy · Live Badder
records.genetics: Trop Cherry × Violet Fog × (Rainbow Beltz #2 x Compound Z)
records.description: Blast off into a cosmic journey of flavor and euphoria with Trop Galaxy. This interstellar blend combines the best of both worlds: the uplifting energy of a sativa and the calming tranquility of an indica. Trop Cherry propels you into orbit with its sweet cherry flavor and stimulating effects, igniting creativity and focus. Violet Fog then guides you back to Earth with its soothing grape aroma and relaxing body high, easing tension and promoting restful sleep.

records.name: Tropical Zerb · Mini Hash Hole
records.notes: An island celebration and gasoline fight
records.description: A tropical knockout built for the small-format sesh. Tropical Zerb pairs Super Boof live rosin with Sunrize Social flower, stacking juicy fruit, candy sweetness, and that unmistakable rosin depth into one tight roll. The Super Boof infusion melts right into the burn, amplifying the flower’s bright tropical character while adding a rich, creamy backbone on the exhale.

records.name: Tropic Like It's Hot · Live Badder
records.notes: Tropical candy dunked in marker ink
records.description: Tropic Like It's Hot blends the bold, chemical-floral punch of Permanent Marker with the bright candy-citrus burst of Pink Z Burst. Sweet mango and tropical fruit hit first, then the signature gassy, soapy marker funk rolls in underneath and lingers.

records.name: Tropic Like It's Hot · Live Sugar

records.name: Tropillini · Sauce Cart
records.description: We love trop terps, and the Tropillini really hits the spot.  A blend of Tropicana Cookies #1 x Bellini from Elevate and GDF, this sativa leaning hybrid brings a good relaxing and calming feel with a nice slow onset of energy that washes over the body and mind.  It's woody and herbal with spicy floral nodes and will wash away any stress or anxiety that your body and mind might be experiencing.

records.name: Trop Juice · Live Badder
records.description: Honeysuckle haze over melted rainbow candy and grape syrup. It opens soft and floral, then thickens into sticky, fruit-soaked sweetness with a low, rolling gas underneath.

records.name: Trop Juice · Live Sugar
records.description: Honeysuckle haze over melted rainbow candy and grape syrup. It opens soft and floral, then thickens into sticky, fruit-soaked sweetness with a low, rolling gas underneath.

records.name: Trop Mama · Live Rosin
records.description: Stinky tropical, citrus terps? Say less! Run, don’t walk to this one, Trop Mama is an out of this world blend of Point Break and Grease Monkey! Sure to leave you stoney and giggly this blend is great for a sesh with the homies or before a chill night by beach!

records.name: Tropollonni · Live Badder
records.description: Presenting Tropollonni! A sun-shiny hybrid blend made with Tropicana Banana + Rager. An insane trip for the senses! With sweet flavors reminiscent of candied bananas, (that may or may not have been dipped in gasoline) really kicking the good ol' serotonin receptors into overdrive! Like a warm hug; enjoy the therapeutic mellow, uplifting effects this new drop has to offer!

records.name: Troppleberry · Sauce Cart
records.description: Orange you glad I DID say Berry? This delicious blend of Clementine x Member Berry gives off INSANE tropical vibes. Berries and oranges take center stage for flavors, transporting you to that sunny beach setting with a happy and giggly stone. Perfect for morning mood-boosting and midday re-motivation.

records.name: TropTruffle MTN · Live Badder
records.description: The Hastronauts had to travel back to the sacred mountain and bring down some new magic, once again! This dank cross of Gas Truffle x Grape MTN brings you the fruit AND the funk. Flavors of fermented grapes mixed with sauteed mushrooms gives you awesomely indica effects that are perfect for social gatherings or chill hangouts before slowly transitioning into a sleepy effect.

records.name: TwoFace · Live Rosin
records.description: Straight outta Gotham, this Project 007 and Grease Monkey blend will treat you like Harvey Dent for a productive and honorable day, while at night bringing out the party animal in all of us. Keep an eye out for the Bat Signal!

records.name: Umami Breath · Mini Hash Hole
records.description: GMO Bomb flower brings the funk, swet and savory, earthy gas - the Umami, while Bat Breath live rosin layers in even more funky goodness. A loud, full-bodied blend with some serious old-school stank.

records.name: Unicorn Farts · Live Badder
records.description: Prepare to embark on a whimsical journey through a land of pure magic with Unicorn Farts, a celestial blend of Blue Goo x Pink Z Burst that will leave you feeling light, airy, and utterly enchanted. This isn't your average bud; it's a cosmic concoction designed to transport you to a realm of pure bliss.

records.name: Uppercut · Live Rosin
records.description: This hybrid blend of BananaConda and Slurricane checks all the boxes! A definite treat for the body and mind that will have your taste buds reminiscing the days spent eating grandma's desserts. You’ll be ready for whatever life throws your way with Uppercut at the ready!

records.name: WatermelaChameleon · Live Badder
records.notes: Peony Melon JollyRancher and Saltwater Taffy
records.description: Water Water Water WatermelaChameleon. This juicy fruity blend of Watermelon Gusherz and Stardawgs is sure to be a tasty. A balanced hybrid good for a mellow head change for the day time or to relax and blend in with any setting.

records.name: Wendigo · Live Badder
records.description: Juicy mixed berries meet sticky pine resin and citrus zest. Expect delicate florals and a smooth earthy finish. Bright on the inhale, classic on the exhale.

records.name: Whit's Puffcake · Sauce Cart
records.description: Like a pie cooling on a window sill, this sweet blend of Guava Cooler and Ice Cream Cake will have you following your nose to the closest rig. This delicious combination of caryophyllene, and limonene is perfect for any occasion! With its musky vanilla undertones, Whit’s Puffcake is sure to be the talk of the town!

records.name: Will Zonka Pop · Live Rosin
records.description: As you inhale the vapor, you'll be enveloped in a cloud of euphoria, your mind drifting away to a place of pure tranquility. The effects of Will Zonka Pop are both uplifting and relaxing, sticking with you like an everlasting gobstopper. But be warned, this isn't just any ordinary high. With Will Zonka Pop, you might just find yourself floating away on a cloud of pure bliss, just like Charlie and his Grandpa Joe in Wonka’s Factory!

records.name: Wook Breath · Live Rosin
records.description: Listen, we know normally it sounds disgusting, but Wook Breath is going to be your favorite new terp profile once you smell it. A super stanky cross of Garlic Breath x Hippie Crasher, this strain provides super sedative effects with lots of pain relief and a lovely indica stone. Make sure when you enter the room, people are asking, “Dude, who the hell has Wook Breath right now?”

records.name: Wookie-Stones · Sauce Cart
records.description: You know how Thanos was looking for the infinity stones? Well, this is sort of like that, except imagine the stones are an insanely fire hash made by an ancient race of wookies that has the power to alter minds and worlds alike! A blend of Tire Fire #4 x Purple Wookies, this strain is sure to be somewhat sedative and extremely mellow– great for binge-watching a certain ‘space battle’ series! Expect funky and earthy flavors followed by a slightly creamy aftertaste.

records.name: Za-Za Li · Live Sugar
records.description: Za-Za Li is a hybrid blend of Fruit Gushers x Rainbow Beltz. This sinfully delicious strain takes over your tastebuds with flavors that reminds us of sour fruit snacks ; sweet, sour and fruity! Enjoy effects of light relaxation, creativity, and mood enhancement.

records.name: Za-Za Mountain · Sauce Cart
records.description: The Hashtronauts have done it again! We brought the magic down from the mountain and created an insanely terpy blend of Grape MTN x Zookies that brings notes of crushed grapes embedded within a warm peanut butter cookie. Effects are relaxing as hell, but more of a social indica – great for going out and hanging with friends!

records.name: Zee Hash · Live Rosin
records.description: Introducing Zee Hash!  A true fusion of classics, this hybrid blend is crossed with Compound Z #2 x Bananaconda. With the help of Zee Hash's powerhouse parents enjoy mellow, soothing, and euphoric effects that feel similar to a warm hug! Indulge in flavors and aromas of funky, sweet gas with smooth vanilla like undertones.

records.name: Ze Lean · Live Badder
records.description: From the homies at HeadChange we present: Ze Lean! Whether you Ze Lean to the left or Ze Lean to the right this blend of Super Lemon Haze and Rager, will have you feeling tight! With heavy notes of citrus and haze this blend is perfect for an uplifting day time high.

records.name: Zippy Ki Aye MOFKR · Live Sugar
records.description: Born from the genetic fusion of Violet Fog and Mental Breakdown #12, this potent concoction delivers a turbocharged experience that'll leave you soaring through clouds of euphoria. Imagine the essence of a violet mist colliding with the intensity of a mental breakthrough, resulting in a blend that's both invigorating and soothing. Whether you're seeking creative inspiration or a moment of profound relaxation, Zippy Ki Aye MOFKR promises an unforgettable journey through the realms of bliss.

records.name: Zkatalites · Live Badder
records.notes: Pack of Shocktarts in a Tire Shop
records.description: Fly me to the moon! We are exuberant about our new drop: Zkatalites! A fusion of Compound Z + Strawberry Candy, this combination is nothing short of a celestial experience. With Strawberry Candy contributing sweet ripe strawberry notes and Compound Z topping it off with spicey vanilla tones, Zkatalites tops the charts with out of this world flavors. Euphoric effects encapsulate your mind and body, slowly sending you into an orbit of pure bliss!

records.name: Zkitty Bop · Sauce Cart
records.description: Zkitty bop is a delightful hybrid blend of Spumoni Cookies, and King Sherb IX. Limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene are the leading terps, coming together to create a strong melon-y aroma, and a sweet, yet bitter taste. This delightful combo is great for any activity!

records.name: Zlooshie · Live Badder
records.description: This delicious blend of Guavaslushie, and Blue Gloo will have you wishing for this flavor at your local snow cone stand. A taste that is sweet, and tart, much like its leading terps: myrcene and limonene, which come together beautifully to create strong sativa effects. No doubt Zlooshie with put a pep in your step (and maybe a snow cone in your hand).

records.name: Zlush Blitz · Mini Hash Hole
records.description: Zlush Blitz combines the sweet, fruity funk of Jordanz flower with our signature tropical-candy heavy Zlush Rain. No need to tip-toe around this delicious doink!

records.name: Zlush Rain · Live Rosin
records.description: Zlush Rain is a flavor-first hybrid that combines the juicy, exotic terp profile of Zlushi with the deeper, slightly gassy and tropical influence of Tiki Rain. These vibrant fruit punch terps are built for flavor chasers.

records.description: This strain will remind you of childhood breakfasts with a fruitiness that is perfectly accompanied by a creamy note akin to sugary cereal milk. A blend of (Zkittles x Gushmints) x Cookies & Cream, the effects are great for pain & stress relief, with a relaxing body high that elevates the mood and helps with anxiety – perfect for wake n’ bakes & nighttime seshes alike!

records.name: Zoo Trip · Sauce Cart
records.genetics: Animal Star Cookies × Kaleidoscope × Violet Fog
records.description: Relive your favorite childhood field trip to the zoo with Zoo Trip!  This hash has a certain funk to it that reminds us of those hot days at the zoo looking at our favorite animals.  Animal Star Cookies, Kaleidoscope, and Violet Fog were the blended strains for this indica-dominant cultivar.
